messages:
jen: FYI auditor Maya requested a concise evidence handoff showing how an RBAC change affected KMS decrypt usage for INF-7301. They want a reproducible playback, minimal sanitized logs, and proof that revert prevents decryption. SOC2 kickoff Wed. Who can own this?

ryan: I can own the runbook and PR links. We should include: PR + approval, CloudTrail snippets for kms:Decrypt and GenerateDataKey, KMS key policy, key rotation export, SIEM alert trace, and a rollback demo (commands + outputs).

"auditor_maya": Thanks 1 concise ask: 1) infra PR that changed role bindings (link + approver + timestamp), 2) ticket that authorized the change, 3) sanitized CloudTrail events for kms:Decrypt / GenerateDataKey referencing the CMK, 4) KMS rotation history CSV or screenshot, 5) SIEM correlation showing alert -> principal -> key ARN, 6) short statement on how ephemeral creds / STS are scoped so they can't decrypt other tenants' ciphertexts. Prefer artifacts that we can replay locally.

anita: I'll prepare a Splunk query and a jq sanitization script. Draft Splunk: 
```splunk
index=aws_cloudtrail eventName IN (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey) requestParameters.keyId=\"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:210987654321:key/wxyz-9876\"
| table _time userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName userIdentity.type eventName requestParameters.keyId errorMessage
| sort _time
```

ryan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/501 1 changed role binding: svc-account-models -> kms-decrypt. Approval ticket: JIRA INF-7301 approved by @ryan at 2024-11-05T09:07:00Z.

jen: Add the KMS key policy JSON and an exported key rotation log (we can get CSV via AWS CLI). Also include a short envelope-encryption diagram and where we store (and TTL) ephemeral data keys.

anita: Sanitization script (jq) draft:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-05T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[].CloudTrailEvent' > raw.json
jq 'map({eventTime:.eventTime, principal:.userIdentity.principalId, eventName:.eventName, keyId:.requestParameters.keyId, outcome:.errorMessage})' raw.json > sanitized-kms.json
```

"auditor_maya": Good. For the rollback proof: show commands used and redacted outputs. Example: aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:... should succeed before revert and return AccessDenied after revert. Screenshots OK.

ryan: We'll create a short shell log showing both states. Example test commands we'll run (redact account ids):
```bash
# before revert
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.ct --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:210987654321:key/wxyz-9876 --profile svc-models
# expect: DecryptionSuccessful + plaintext output

# after revert
# revoke role binding and retry
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.ct --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:210987654321:key/wxyz-9876 --profile svc-models
# expect: An error with AccessDenied or notAuthorized redacted
```

anita: SIEM rule for this flow: SIEM-2024-6011. I'll include an alert reproduction (redacted ids), and a mapping file: control -> artifact (control: CC-5.1 -> artifacts/INF-7301/sanitized-kms.json -> proof statement).

ops-bot: Upload reminder: use secure evidence path s3://audit-evidence/INF-7301/2024-11-05. Use presigned URLs (48h) and label files per manifest.

ryan: We'll also include a signed manifest.txt with filenames, SHA256 sums, and control mapping. I'll open PR for the runbook with the manifest link. Draft ETA: Thursday EOD.

jen: Also flag the vuln triage note: the change was in response to CVE-2024-4451 in an SDK. Add the patch PR link and note that the RBAC change was part of mitigation steps. That gives context for auditor playback.

"auditor_maya": Perfect 1 include the patch PR and short triage note. Please ensure no PII/PHI in samples. We may ask for a short call to replay the bundle.

jen: Owners: ryan (runbook + manifest + patch PR links), anita (logs + Splunk + sanitization), jen (bundle assembly + upload). I'll post the presigned bundle link when ready. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
